description: A fast page lets people read and act without a long wait. Performance work starts with measuring a real task. Learn how images, scripts, styles and layout choices affect the way a page feels. Use a local test page and browser developer tools. Code samples show a page choice or a measurement. Compare before and after under the same conditions; exact timings depend on the device and network.
versionNote: Uses current Core Web Vitals concepts: LCP, INP and CLS, plus standard browser tools.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to match a jumping button to the measure that tracks movement
Learn to compare the chosen image request at two viewport sizes
Learn to change the movement distance and observe the box
learningObjectives: Learn to match a jumping button to the measure that tracks movement
Learn to compare the chosen image request at two viewport sizes
Learn to change the movement distance and observe the box
